text: Hi Gilad - yes there will be trouble with reentering without an intervisa, even if you are travelling together, and even if it is only once per year. If your branch allows walk ins, you will need to go early in the morning during their walk-in hours and ask for one (will need to pay around 180 NIS). The branches are closed this week for sukkot, so you will need to go next week - any morning except Wednesday.
